title: Drawer
summary: A bottom drawer is the system sheet with detents and a visible drag indicator. Monarch ships nothing.
whenToUse: For a short task or a set of options that should leave part of the screen visible: filters, a picker, details of a map pin. Offer a medium detent, and a large one if the content can grow.
whenNotToUse: For a task that needs the whole screen use a plain sheet or fullScreenCover (see dialog). For choosing one of a few actions use confirmationDialog (see choice-dialog).
api: func sheet(isPresented: Binding<Bool>, onDismiss: (() -> Void)? = nil, content: @escaping () -> some View) -> some View
func presentationDetents(_ detents: Set<PresentationDetent>) -> some View
func presentationDragIndicator(_ visibility: Visibility) -> some View
func interactiveDismissDisabled(_ isDisabled: Bool = true) -> some View

states.name: medium
states.description: The sheet covers about half the screen; the content behind is dimmed.

states.name: large
states.description: Dragging the indicator up grows the sheet to full height, when the large detent is offered.

states.name: dragged down
states.description: Dragging down past the smallest detent closes the sheet, unless interactiveDismissDisabled is set.

appearance: The system draws the sheet's card, its corner radius, the grab handle and the dimming in every theme. The content is the app's: give it a theme background such as bgRaised and it follows the four themes.
platformNotes: The web Drawer is a bottom panel for phones with a grab handle and dragToClose, built on the web Sheet. On iOS it is the same sheet as any other, sized with detents; the grab handle is presentationDragIndicator(.visible), and dragToClose={false} is interactiveDismissDisabled(). Detents can also be a fixed height or a fraction. On an iPad at regular width the sheet is centred and detents have no effect. Android uses ModalBottomSheet.
accessibility: System behaviour: the sheet is modal and confines VoiceOver, Switch Control and keyboard focus.
System behaviour: the drag indicator is an adjustable element; VoiceOver swipes up and down to change the detent.
System behaviour: the escape gesture closes the sheet.
Keep a visible button that closes the drawer, so closing does not depend on a drag.
edgeCases: A scroll view inside a sheet with several detents first grows the sheet and then scrolls.
With interactiveDismissDisabled and no close button the drawer cannot be closed.
On a phone in landscape a medium detent is as tall as the screen.
